Earnings growth: weakening demand noted in Q4 2022/Q1 2023 [D03]

drivers.driver: The business operates with extreme geographic concentration of its most critical assets in Taiwan, creating a binary risk outside management control [D01, D05].
A current holder must weigh the high quality of the foundry franchise against the unquantifiable risk of interruption to its core production [D01].
Recent results indicate a cooling demand environment and inventory adjustments, moving away from the peak-margin performance of 2022 [D03].
We choose to hold a smaller, less risky position in light of these non-economic variables, prioritizing the protection of capital over potential upside [D05, D08].

final.memo:
the Company is a business of immense technical capability and scale, earning impressive returns on capital [D01, D02]. Charlie and I have long admired companies that possess a durable competitive advantage and pricing power, and this foundry clearly fits that description in its operating results [D01]. However, even a wonderful business becomes a questionable holding if the geographic concentration of its assets exposes the company—and its shareholders—to a potential catastrophic interruption [D01, D05].

While the foundry manufacturing process provides a significant moat, that moat does not protect the assets from geopolitical events outside the reach of even the most able management [D01, D05]. We have seen 2022 produce record financial performance, but we must look forward, not backward [D02, D03]. With management noting weaker demand and necessary inventory adjustments in the coming period, the cyclical nature of this industry is becoming more apparent [D03].

We do not care to be in the business of measuring geopolitical probabilities [D05]. When an investment carries a risk that could lead to the permanent loss of the capital deployed—or indeed the entire asset base—the intelligent course is to limit our exposure [D05]. We are therefore trimming our position to a level that balances our respect for the business's current economics against the reality of its location [D05, D08]. Any gains realized will be subject to the 21% federal tax, a cost we accept to sleep better with our remaining investment [S3].
